body:
A smile you are happy with changes how you carry yourself. Cosmetic dentistry has become more precise and more accessible, and understanding the main options helps you choose well. Here are the five procedures patients in Valencia and Santa Clarita ask about most, how each works, and what to weigh before you decide. Dr. Nuriel Lavi plans every cosmetic case personally, with digital scanning and in-house crown fabrication where they help.

## 1. Teeth whitening

Whitening is the most requested cosmetic treatment. Teeth pick up stain from food, drink, age and habits. In a survey by the American Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry, 74 percent of adults said an unattractive smile can hurt career success.

**How it works.** Professional whitening uses hydrogen peroxide or carbamide peroxide to lift stain from enamel. In-office treatment can lighten teeth several shades in a single visit. Take-home trays work more slowly but can produce similar results.

**What to expect.** Results typically last six months to two years, depending on diet and habits such as coffee or smoking.

**Consider.** Over-the-counter products exist, but professional whitening is safer for your gums and more predictable. An exam first rules out decay or sensitivity that whitening could aggravate. Learn more about [teeth whitening](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/teeth-whitening/).

## 2. Porcelain veneers

Veneers are thin shells of porcelain or composite resin bonded to the front of teeth. They suit chipped, discolored, worn or mildly misaligned teeth.

**The process.**

1. Consultation to define your goals and preview the result.
2. Preparation, removing a small amount of enamel so the veneer sits flush.
3. Bonding the veneer to the tooth with a dental adhesive.

**Benefits.** Veneers are matched to the color and shape of your natural teeth, and with proper care they often last 10 to 15 years. Long-term studies report high survival rates at ten years.

**Consider.** Because enamel is removed, veneers are not reversible. Weigh that carefully before you commit. See our [veneers page](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/veneers/) for details.

## 3. Invisalign

Invisalign straightens teeth with a series of clear, removable aligners instead of brackets and wires.

**How it works.** A digital scan creates a 3D model of your teeth, and the treatment plan is mapped from it. You wear each set of aligners 20 to 22 hours a day and change to the next set every one to two weeks.

**Benefits.** The aligners are nearly invisible, which appeals to adults. Smooth plastic also means less irritation to cheeks and gums than metal braces.

**What to expect.** Most patients finish in 12 to 18 months.

**Consider.** Results depend on wearing the aligners as directed. If you know you tend to forget, tell us so we can plan around it. Read more about [Invisalign](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/invisalign/).

## 4. Dental crowns

A crown is a custom cap that covers a damaged, decayed or heavily filled tooth, restoring its shape, strength and appearance. Crowns sit at the border of restorative and cosmetic dentistry.

**The process.**

1. Examination and a discussion of materials: porcelain, metal or a combination.
2. Shaping the tooth and taking a digital impression.
3. Placing the crown. With in-house fabrication, a same-day crown is often possible; otherwise a temporary is worn while the final crown is made.

**Benefits.** Crowns protect weak teeth from further damage, restore chewing, and serve many roles, including after a root canal or as anchors for a bridge.

**What to expect.** With proper care, crowns commonly last 10 to 15 years or longer.

**Consider.** Cost varies with material, and some cases need more than one visit. See [dental crowns](/services/dental-crowns/).

## 5. Dental bonding

Bonding applies a tooth-colored composite resin to repair small chips, close minor gaps or reshape a tooth.

**The process.**

1. The tooth surface is lightly roughened and a conditioning liquid is applied.
2. The resin is applied, shaped and polished to blend with the surrounding teeth.

**Benefits.** Bonding is usually finished in one visit, costs less than veneers or crowns, and removes little or no enamel.

**What to expect.** Bonding typically lasts 3 to 10 years, depending on where it sits and how you care for it.

**Consider.** It is less durable than porcelain, so it suits minor repairs rather than large changes. Related: [composite fillings](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/composite-filling/).

## Which one is right for you

Whitening, veneers, Invisalign, crowns and bonding each solve a different problem, and many smile plans combine two or more. The right starting point is an exam and a conversation about what you want to change. Dr. Lavi sees you personally at every visit and explains the options in plain terms, including what each one costs. Learn more on our [cosmetic dentistry page](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/), or call (661) 254-5200 to book a consultation at our Valencia office.
